evals.prompt: We sell invoicing software to freelancers in Germany. I have keys for Firecrawl, DataForSEO, Google Ads, Search Console and Meta, and no Apify token. Plan the competitor and keyword research with the stack-ads toolkit. Do not inspect the project and do not run commands. Answer with at most 7 numbered lines, in the order you would go: one toolkit command or one question to me per line.
evals.expected_output: A short ordered list: a research budget question before paid calls, the Meta Ad Library, Search Console as seeds, a keyword data step
expectations: The answer includes a `meta ad-library` command with a `--countries` value
The answer includes a keyword step that uses `dataforseo post` or `google keyword-ideas`
The answer uses Search Console (`gsc query`) as a source of seed queries
The answer states the cost of the paid calls or asks to agree a research budget before the first paid call
